meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把当前代码和已发布的 npm 版本做对比,列出所有还没发布的改动,按发布层级分类,并给出每层和整体的版本号建议。
howto.when: 当你提到「unpublished changes」「changelog」「what changed」等关键词,或询问有哪些未发布改动时触发。

say.text: 看看有哪些未发布的改动
say.note: 它会对比本地与已发布 npm 版本并列出。

say.text: 按发布层级生成未发布改动的清单
say.note: 它输出分层影响矩阵和版本建议。

say.text: 对比 HEAD 和最新 npm 版本,有什么变化?
say.note: 它针对 oh-my-opencode 等包做差异分析。

howto.what_en: Claude compares the current HEAD with the latest published npm versions, lists all unpublished changes by release layer, and recommends a layer-specific version bump plus one overall release bump.
howto.when_en: Triggered by keywords such as 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', or when asking what changes have not been released yet.

say_en.note: It diffs the local code against published npm versions.

say_en.text: Generate a changelog grouped by release layer
say_en.note: It outputs the layered impact matrix and version recommendations.

say_en.text: Compare HEAD with the latest npm versions, what changed?
say_en.note: It analyzes diffs for packages like oh-my-opencode.
